accounting_rule: commander armies are assignment views sourced from state manpower pools unless explicitly independent; creating an army never creates people

armies.name: Ouki Army
armies.doctrine_state: commander-specific doctrine and familiarity develop after assignment
armies.cohesion_state: depends on actual time under command
armies.named_officer_accounting: Commander and materialized named officers/staff are separate people. Routine headquarters functions use staff_role_ids; neither representation creates anonymous unit manpower.
armies.return_rule: Assigned units return to their source state establishment with current condition/history; this army view does not own or regenerate manpower.
